title: Add Aldea as STT provider alongside Deepgram and OpenAI
description: High-level goal: support Aldea Speech-to-Text as a third STT extractor. Config: aldea.api_key in user config and ALDEA_API_KEY env var (env wins). API: POST https://api.aldea.ai/v1/listen, Bearer auth; response shape matches Deepgram (channels/alternatives/transcript). Implementation should mirror stt-deepgram and stt-openai: optional extra, user config resolution, Pydantic config, BDD specs, and docs. Sub-tasks (beads): user config + resolver, stt-aldea extractor, BDD feature + steps, docs and README.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
